summary.text:
# 科技发展：原始星球的挫折 / Technological Development: Setback on a Pre-FTL Planet
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 观察站（前FTL观察）事件 pre-FTL observation event

## 如何开始 How it starts

五年一次的前FTL科技事件池 on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl_tech_events（权重 10/270，`00_on_actions.txt:563–575`）。条件：存在被我方“开放科技启蒙”（或被间谍行动盯上）的前FTL国家，其物种具有 “令人厌恶”特质，且尚未设置 repugnant_learners_development 标志。/ Entry: the five-year pre-FTL tech pool (weight 10 of 270). Needs an observed country under open technological enlightenment whose species has trait_repugnant and no repugnant_learners_development flag.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**科技发展：[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的挫折**：隐藏效果标记该国并给其科技情境 -384（相当于一次进度）；唯一选项仅作确认。/ Flags the country and changes its tech-progress situation by -384; the only option acknowledges.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

线性，单事件。/ Single event.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

触发依赖物种特质。/ Depends on a species trait.
